cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Spare Them the Hassle
cards.instruction: Hide a practical problem because you believe handling it alone is kinder than involving anyone else.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Read your book. I'll have your bike ready tomorrow; repair collections need one coordinator, not two people making calls.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The shop just asked me to collect a wheel.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: They used the owner number instead of the collection contact. Forward it to me, please. You are off duty.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They say the frame is at a different shop. How bad is it?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Nothing for your afternoon off. I'll collect the frame first and the wheel second. Please stop creating a second collection route; I've arranged yours to end at that chair.

reason: Make professional routing and contact corrections conceal the repair complexity while explicitly protecting B leisure, with B second-shop information shaping the route.
